answer: Each key locks 200 POA into an epoch escrow. The beacon assigns one random challenge from the last ten epochs; the key must re-answer it in a 30-minute window. A sybil farm with a hundred keys cannot copy one answer — it must solve ten distinct past challenges. Graders re-run; mismatch or duplicate slashes 100 POA per key, half to the reporter. One hundred fake keys lock 20,000 POA and bleed on every wrong reveal: expensive to run, cheap to audit. Copying one answer into a hundred keys is like planting one comet in a meadow and hoping the tundra does not notice.
